title: Roasted Earthy Flaky Crumble
description: A hearty, comforting dessert with a crunchy topping and a rich, earthy flavor.

ingredients.name: chuck roast
ingredients.notes: diced, used for the crumble topping

ingredients.name: roast potato
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced, used for the base of the crumble

instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry and place on a baking sheet.
Arrange the thinly sliced roast potatoes on top of the pastry.
In a separate bowl, mix together the diced chuck roast, brown sugar, and a pinch of salt.
Sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the potatoes.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the crumble is crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
